newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat easier on weather.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat easier on weather.

text.p: Argentine cash wheat eased in good volume cash market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, as sunny weather dried out soaked crops and allowed harvesting to get back into swing, traders said.

But the market had started even weaker, before concern grew about harvest delays caused by recent storms. March cash wheat had slipped $3 to $137, farmers prices, by midsession. April cash maize was steady at $98 in middling volume, as exporters took positions. May soybeans eased $2 to $235, with buyer interest ebbing. March sunfseed was steady at $214, with prices supported by recent bad weather in the north.
